## Confidence and signal

HIGH and MEDIUM findings enter the review decision at their priority. LOW findings, at any priority, go to Needs investigation and are excluded from the decision.

## Review decision

| Findings | Decision |
|---|---|
| Any HIGH or MEDIUM P1 | REQUEST_CHANGES |
| Any P2 | REQUEST_CHANGES |
| HIGH or MEDIUM P3 only | COMMENT |
| None, or LOW only | APPROVE |
